thread.title: Tigress Financial Keeps a Buy Rating on Apple (AAPL)

author: Austin Angelo
title: Tigress Financial Keeps a Buy Rating on Apple (AAPL)
text:
By Austin Angelo
In a report released today, Ivan Feinseth from Tigress Financial reiterated a Buy rating on Apple ( AAPL – Research Report ). The company’s shares opened today at $169.60.
According to TipRanks.com , Feinseth is a 5-star analyst with an average return of 15.3% and a 61.1% success rate. Feinseth covers the Services sector, focusing on stocks such as Southwest Airlines, Royal Caribbean, and Starbucks Corp.
Apple has an analyst consensus of Moderate Buy, with a price target consensus of $228.31, which is a 34.6% upside from current levels. In a report issued on November 26, Loop Capital Markets also maintained a Buy rating on the stock with a $225 price target.

Based on Apple’s latest earnings release for the quarter ending September 30, the company reported a quarterly revenue of $62.68 billion and net profit of $14.13 billion. In comparison, last year the company earned revenue of $52.57 billion and had a net profit of $10.71 billion.
